content.title: How to watch UConn vs. Duke men’s basketball: Elite Eight TV channel and streaming options for March 29
content.text: The No. 1 seed Duke Blue Devils (35-2) and No. 2 seed UConn Huskies (32-5) will play for a spot in the NCAA Tournament Final Four on Sunday at Capital One Arena, starting at 5:05 p.m. ET.How to watch UConn Huskies vs. Duke Blue Devils Venue: Capital One Arena Time: 5:05 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. UConn vs. Duke odds Spread: Duke -5.5 (-108), UConn +5.5 (-112) Favorite Moneyline: Duke -249 Underdog Moneyline: UConn +200 Total: 134.5 Total Over Odds: -111 Total Under Odds: -111 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Duke outscores opponents by 18.5 points per game (scoring 81.9 per game to rank 50th in college basketball while giving up 63.4 per outing to rank fourth in college basketball) and has a +685 scoring differential overall. Duke connects on 8.8 three-pointers per game (99th in college basketball) at a 34.6% rate (151st in college basketball), compared to the 8.2 its opponents make while shooting 30.8% from deep. UConn has a +452 scoring differential, topping opponents by 12.2 points per game. It is putting up 77.2 points per game, 142nd in college basketball, and is allowing 65.0 per contest to rank 10th in college basketball. UConn knocks down 8.2 three-pointers per game (136th in college basketball), 2.3 more than its opponents. It shoots 34.9% from deep (123rd in college basketball), and its opponents are shooting 30.6%.
